name: organization_audit_event_branches
description: Branches an organization audit event concerns; branch managers read only events whose branches all lie within their own branches.
lifecycle: Written with the event; never updated or deleted by the runtime. An event without rows is a company-level operation.

columns.Meaning: Company shared by the event and the branch.
Audit event that concerns the branch.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, branch_id) REFERENCES branches(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The branch belongs to the same company; mixed-company audit scopes are unrepresentable.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, event_id) REFERENCES organization_audit_events(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The event belongs to the same company.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id) REFERENCES companies(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The row belongs to an existing company.
A branch appears at most once per event.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX organization_audit_event_branches_branch_idx ON public.organization_audit_event_branches USING btree (company_id, branch_id)
constraints.Purpose: Supports finding the events that concern a branch.
